full_prompt_en: A square geometric digital painting constructs a single face from overlapping bars, wedges, curves, and rectangular color planes against a deep black background. The head occupies most of the frame, offset slightly to the right, while broken vertical bands extend above and below it. A pale yellow central strip and several orange-red blocks form the upper face. One heavy dark eyebrow and a narrow closed eye sit near the upper middle; the other side of the face is obscured by a long overlapping slab. A sharp triangular orange plane projects at the right as a nose, catching bright warm light along its edge. Below it, a blue-gray curved lip shape and a dark horizontal opening suggest a quiet, unsmiling mouth. The lower cheek and chin are assembled from olive, muted gold, rust, teal, and charcoal pieces, some receding into deep slots between the planes. On the left, a broad horizontal gray bar and stacked ocher rectangles push into the head, giving the portrait the depth of an angular relief sculpture. The surrounding black remains visible in wide margins at both sides and at the lower left, where the colored construction ends abruptly. Each plane carries fine parallel grain or subtle linear striping, as if painted wood or layered print surfaces were joined together. Directional light appears to come from above and slightly right, brightening the ocher and orange front edges while casting hard shadows into the recessed dark gaps. No readable text appears. The overall composition is dense and architectural in form, yet recognizably human, balancing warm vertical color against cool blue-gray shadows and deep surrounding black.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形几何数字绘画在深黑背景前，以相叠的色条、楔形、曲线和矩形色面构成一张面容。头部占据画面大部分空间，略偏右侧，破碎的纵向色带伸向头顶和下缘。一条浅黄中央色条与数块橙红形体组成上半张脸。一道厚深眉和一只狭窄闭合的眼睛位于上方中央附近；脸的另一侧被一块长长的重叠平板遮住。右侧突出的橙色尖三角平面成为鼻子，边缘接住明亮暖光。其下，蓝灰色弯曲唇形与一道深色水平开口暗示安静而不笑的嘴。下脸颊与下巴由橄榄绿、低饱和金色、锈红、青绿和炭黑色碎片组装，有些退入平面之间的深槽。左侧一道宽灰横条和层叠赭色矩形推入头部，让肖像拥有带棱角的浮雕纵深。周围黑色在两侧与左下保留宽阔边距，那里的彩色结构突然结束。每个平面都有细平行颗粒或隐约线性条纹，仿佛彩绘木板或层叠印刷表面拼在一起。定向光似乎从上方稍偏右来，照亮赭黄与橙色前缘，在后退的暗缝里投下硬影。画中没有可读文字。整体构图密集，形态近似建筑结构，却仍然可辨为人脸，以暖色纵向色彩平衡冷蓝灰阴影与周围深黑。
style_prompt_en: The digital painting assembles overlapping rectangular, curved, and wedge-shaped planes into a dense shallow relief. Warm yellow, orange, rust, and muted red alternate with teal, slate blue, olive, and charcoal; thin bands of one hue interrupt larger fields of another. Edges are crisp and angular at projecting planes, while fine parallel grain softens their surfaces. Bright directional light strikes exposed upper and side faces and leaves narrow recesses nearly black, giving the construction a pronounced stepped volume. Broad dark negative space surrounds the central cluster, making its compact color rhythm more forceful. Repetition of long vertical strips is checked by occasional horizontal bars and sweeping curves. The overall effect is sculptural and modern, with color, overlap, and hard shadow providing structure.
style_prompt_zh: 这种数字绘画把相叠的矩形、曲面和楔形平面组装成密集的浅浮雕。暖黄、橙、锈色和低饱和红与青绿、石板蓝、橄榄绿及炭黑交替；一个色相的细条不断切入另一种颜色的大色面。向前突出的平面边缘清晰而带角，细平行颗粒则软化表面。明亮定向光照到暴露的上面和侧面，狭窄凹处几乎漆黑，赋予结构明显的台阶式体积。宽阔暗负空间围住中央色团，使紧凑的颜色节奏更有力。长纵条的重复由偶尔出现的水平色条和横扫曲线调节。整体效果富有雕塑感和现代感，以色彩、遮挡与硬影提供结构。
theme_en: A face assembled from layered colored geometric planes against black
theme_zh: 黑色底面前由彩色几何平面层叠成的面容
name: Adam Neate
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
